subject: general
question: Bharatanatyam is traditionally performed to which type of music?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Carnatic**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharatanatyam** is traditionally performed in **Carnatic music**.
 
• **Carnatic music** is a** classical music** tradition originating from** South India**.
 
• It features **intricate melodies**,** rhythmic patterns**, and **compositions **in languages like **Telugu, Tamil, and Sanskrit**.
 
• **Bharatanatyam dancers **synchronize their movements with the rhythm and melody of **Carnatic music** during performances.
 
• **Bharatanatyam**, a **classical dance **form from** Tamil Nadu**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Baul**

 
 
• **Baul **is a **spiritual and musical tradition** from **Bengal**.
 
• It explores themes of **love, devotion, and spiritual enlightenment**.
 
• Typically accompanied by **instruments** like **ektara, dotara, and khamak**.
 
 
 
• **Hindustani**
 
 
• **Hindustani music **is the** classical music** tradition of **North India**.
 
• It features **rich melodies**, **intricate rhythms**, and** improvisation**.
 
• Common instruments include **sitar, tabla**, **sarangi**, and **flute**.
 
 
 
• **Lavani**
 
 
• **Lavani** is a traditional **dance and musical** **form** from **Maharashtra**, **India**.
 
• Known for its **energetic movements**,** rhythmic footwork**, and **expressive storytelling**.
 
• **Lavani **often explores themes of l**ove, romance, and social issues**.
